description: This file contains functions and constants for installing and managing plugins from ClawHub, including error handling, version resolution, validation, logging, and the main installation process.

methods.name: formatClawHubSpecifier
methods.description: Formats a ClawHub plugin specifier string from name and optional version.

methods.name: buildClawHubInstallFailure
methods.description: Constructs a ClawHubInstallFailure object with error message and code.

methods.name: mapClawHubRequestError
methods.description: Maps an error from ClawHub request to a ClawHubInstallFailure, handling 404 errors specifically.

methods.name: resolveRequestedVersion
methods.description: Determines the requested version or resolves to the latest available version.

methods.name: resolveCompatiblePackageVersion
methods.description: Fetches and verifies the package version and compatibility, returning success or failure.

methods.name: validateClawHubPluginPackage
methods.description: Validates package family, privacy, and compatibility against runtime version.

methods.name: logClawHubPackageSummary
methods.description: Logs information about the ClawHub package, including version, family, channel, and compatibility.

methods.name: installPluginFromClawHub
methods.description: Main function to install a plugin from ClawHub, handling spec parsing, version resolution, validation, download, and installation.
